Nigel Farage's remarks on Indian migration and UK immigration plans

Nigel Farage, a prominent British political figure, has stated that Indian migration to the UK would be restricted to highly skilled individuals if he were to become Prime Minister. This statement comes amidst reports of Reform UK's plans that could affect EU nationals residing in Britain, sparking concerns about their rights.
